prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1263; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the collision that occurred while our client was turning left at an intersection. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical care. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter, including requests for statements, scheduling, and settlement discussions, exclusively to our office and refrain from contacting our client directly.

We ask that you provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits under the policy issued to the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page confirming those limits and any other coverage that may apply.

We also request that your company preserve all evidence related to this loss. This includes the claim file, photographs, dashcam or vehicle telematics data, recorded statements, repair and appraisal records, and any electronic data from the vehicles involved. Please ensure that no such materials are altered, discarded, or destroyed while the claim remains open.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
